name: Isaiah White
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 6A

items.text: Isaiah White is a special education classroom assistant at Chicago Public Schools and a former substitute teacher. He worked on the 2024 campaign of board member Jessica Biggs.

sentences.text: Isaiah White is a special education classroom assistant at Chicago Public Schools and a former substitute teacher.
He worked on the 2024 campaign of board member Jessica Biggs.

items.text: His main priority is raising reading and math scores, partly by boosting pay for teaching assistants and hiring more effective school leaders. His campaign says he will protect selective enrollment and options schools from admission changes or closures. He told the Chicago Tribune that CPS has built "a system without accountability" for failing schools. He also wants to serve as a full-time board member and require board members to disclose income.
